# DiscoveryTech Hub

> DiscoveryTech Hub, a vertical of DiscoveryHub, is an ICT solutions company in Abuja, Nigeria offering web design and development, ICT training, graphic design, branding, printing, proposal and report writing, and ICT consultancy. It also rents a fully equipped multipurpose space in Abuja that seats 22 people.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://discoverytechhub.com/): overview of services, process and FAQ
- [Services](https://discoverytechhub.com/services): the seven services with key features
- [The Hub (space rental)](https://discoverytechhub.com/hub): 22-seat multipurpose space, amenities, pricing and booking
- [About](https://discoverytechhub.com/about): mission, vision, values and working process
- [Get a quote](https://discoverytechhub.com/quote): contact details and quote request form

## Facts
- Location: Plot 740 Aminu Kano Crescent, Wuse 2, FCT Abuja, Abuja, Nigeria
- Working hours: Monday to Friday 8:00-18:00, Saturday 9:00-15:00
- Email: info@discoverytechhub.com
- Phone: +234 904 746 5802, +234 807 685 4730
- Hub space: seats up to 22 people, NGN 80,000 per full day (negotiable for multi-day bookings), constant power, air conditioning, projector and screen, PA system, restrooms; internet not included
